newsitem.title: UK: UK's Kenwood ends takeover talks with Pifco.
newsitem.headline: UK's Kenwood ends takeover talks with Pifco.

text.p: UK kitchen appliance company Kenwood Appliances Plc said on Tuesday that it had ended takeover talks with Pifco Holdings Plc.
Pifco made a proposal recently, which Kenwood said in a statement its directors had considered, but did not believe would lead to a satisfactory offer that could be put to shareholders.
"Discussions, therefore, have been terminated and as a result, Kenwood is no longer in an offer period," Kenwood said.
Kenwood was placed in an offer period, after an announcement by Pifco on December 12 1996 that it was interested in making an offer for Kenwood.
Kenwood said then it had received various approaches from Pifco, including receipt of a letter in July 1996, which contained outline proposals for merging the two businesses.
Although this was not a formal offer, it was given consideration by the Kenwood Board and rejected.
Kenwood said that during early 1997, further limited discussions were held with Pifco and its advisers, but Pifco's proposal had again been rejected.
